newsitem.title: USA: House approves minting of three coins.
newsitem.headline: House approves minting of three coins.

text.p: The House voted Tuesday to authorise the minting of three commemorative coins in honour of George Washington, James and Dolly Madison and blacks who fought in the American Revolution.

The legislation calls for the minting of 100,000 $5 gold coins for the 200th anniversary of Washington's death in 1999; 500,000 $1 silver coins for the 250th anniversary of James Madison's birth in 1999 and 500,000 $1 silver coins for the 275th anniversary in 1998 of the birth of Crispus Attucks, a black who was the first American killed in the revolution.

Money from the sale of the coins will be used to support the preservation of the homes of Washington and Madison in Virginia and to fund construction of a Black Revolutionary War Patriots Memorial in Washington.
The three separate bills were passed by voice vote and sent to the Senate.
